content: We need to find a retrosynthetic template for carbonyl-ene reaction. The forward reaction: carbonyl + alkene -> new C-C bond, C=O to C-O, C=C to C-C, forming alcohol and five-membered ring. So retrosynthesis: break the C-O bond (alcohol) to carbonyl, break C-C bond to alkene. So we need a template that does carbonyl-ene. Use search with functional_groups_broken: ["ketones"], functional_groups_formed: ["aliphatic hydroxyls"], bonds_broken: maybe "C=O" and "C=C". But bonds format expects "6-6" etc. We can omit bonds criteria. Provide only functional groups. Let's try search with functional_groups_broken ["ketones"], functional_groups_formed ["aliphatic hydroxyls"].
